about: W1 and W2 share these: the watch tag is "w:" plus the first 10 hex of SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of q trimmed, lowercased and with whitespace runs collapsed to one space. tests/js/phrase.test.js checks the phone's two hashes and the Pages Function's against them; tests/test_w1_interests.py checks fetcher/watch.py's tag_for.
